verdict.rationale: Productboard advertises automatic AI-driven insight detection that links feedback to related feature ideas, and its Analytics API references 'Insights usage' metrics, suggesting a built-in insights feature. However, the evidence gives no detail on how suggestions are generated, no examples of AI-generated recommendations beyond linking, and no independent/hands-on validation of quality. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the AI/insight engine, breadth of suggestion types, and independent corroboration of usefulness/accuracy.
